data.content_ref: inline:The target fails to propose a substantive relation because the 'refuted if' condition describes a collapse into induction (a meta-logical critique of validity) rather than specifying a failure of the named relation type (dependence). The prompt requires stating what the specific relation (dependence) is refuted if; instead, the target argues that the entire framework is circular. It substitutes a defense of the relation's soundness for the required definition of the relation's falsification conditions, effectively answering 'why this might be wrong generally' instead of 'under what specific condition this dependence fails'.
